# Workflow 3 — Contact Enrichment

**What it does:** This workflow takes only the **Approved** candidates, finds their official websites, and collects publicly available contact details like email addresses, phone numbers, and contact forms. It then saves these details in the `Business_Leads` tab.

**Limit:** Each run can process up to **5 businesses**. You can change this limit in `Run_Config > Contacts_Per_Run`.

**Lead Status:**
- `Ready` — Contact details were found.
- `Needs_Contact` — No contact details were found.
- `Needs_Check` — The website, business identity, or opening date needs to be checked.

**Important:** The workflow only saves real contact details it finds. It does not create or guess any email addresses or phone numbers.

## 1. Read Config and Data

First, open the **Config** node and paste your Google Sheet ID.

Then, select your Google account credentials in all Google Sheets nodes.

## 2. Get Approved Businesses

Pick only the businesses where `Review_Status` is `Approved`, `Processed` is empty, and `Business_Name` is filled in.

Make sure the same business is selected only once in each run.

## 3. Find the Official Website

Search for the business on Google. Skip social media and directory websites, and select the first genuine official business website.

## 4. Check the Website

Open the homepage and contact page to find the business details.

First, check if the business name appears on the homepage to make sure it is the correct website. Only then save the email, phone number, or contact form.

If the website does not open or has any issues, the workflow will continue without stopping. The lead will be marked as `Needs_Check` or `Needs_Contact`.

## 5. Save and Check for Duplicates

Before saving, check if the same business already exists in the same city and location.

If it already exists, update the existing lead instead of creating a new one. Make sure empty values do not replace existing information.

Once the lead is successfully saved, mark the candidate as `Processed = Yes`.
